steps: Earn every other trophy in the base game. The 12 Valhalla DLC trophies are not required.
Play the story first, then clear every realm to 100% and beat the optional bosses King Hrólf and Gná.
communityNotes: Reddit tip: clear one realm at a time using the map legend and finish every favor in it — that sweeps up almost every non-story trophy.

achievements.name: The Florist
achievements.description: Collect one flower from each of the nine realms

steps: Pick up any flower to start Favor: Nine Realms in Bloom.
Collect one flower in each of the nine realms — nine in total. The in-game map tracks them per region.
Complete the favor once the ninth flower is collected.
Collect all 14 Kvasir's Poems — they are Artifact pickups scattered across the realms.
You will finish this automatically while going for The Curator; the map tracks Artifacts per region.
Collect all 38 Artifacts across Svartalfheim, Alfheim, Vanaheim, Midgard, Helheim and Muspelheim.
Complete the Casualties of War favors in The Crater of Vanaheim — those pickups count as Artifacts too.
Use the per-region Artifact counter on the map to find whatever is left.
This is automatic during Main Quest 06: The Reckoning, right after the Níðhögg fight, when the Amulet of Yggdrasil is handed to you.
Craft the first Amulet enchantment when the tutorial prompt appears and equip it.
Visit any blacksmith — Sindri's House is the earliest.
Upgrade any single armor piece (chest, wrist or waist) by one level.
Unlocks automatically at the start of Main Quest 12: Reunion.
It fires once Kratos has all three Spartan Rage types — Valour, Wrath and Fury — which are all story unlocks, so there is nothing extra to do.

achievements.name: Full Belly
achievements.description: Obtain all of the Apples of Iðunn and Horns of Blood Mead

steps: Open all 35 Nornir Chests across the nine realms — each awards either an Apple of Iðunn (health) or a Horn of Blood Mead (Spartan Rage).
Which of the two you get depends on how many you have already opened, so just keep opening Nornir Chests until both pools are full.
The map tracks Nornir Chests per region, so use it to hunt down the last few.
Open the Skills menu.
Buy any skill with XP — you earn XP from the main story and from favors.
Story trophy: unlocks during Main Quest 01: Surviving Fimbulwinter, after the fight against the bear.
Story trophy: unlocks during Main Quest 01: Surviving Fimbulwinter, after the fight against Thor.
The Mysterious Valkyrie is Freya — the fight happens at the very start of Main Quest 06: The Reckoning, in the Lower Wildwoods of Midgard.
Beat her to unlock the trophy; it cannot be missed.
Story trophy: unlocks during Main Quest 06: The Reckoning, after the Níðhögg boss fight.
Story trophy: unlocks during Main Quest 05: The Lost Sanctuary in Jotunheim.
Destroy Grýla's cauldron during, and at the end of, the boss fight.
Story trophy: unlocks after the Garm boss fight in Helheim.
Story trophy: unlocks during Main Quest 13: Creatures of Prophecy, after the Heimdall fight.
Story trophy: unlocks during Main Quest 16: The Summoning, after the Hrist and Mist fight.
Collect all five shields: three are crafted at a blacksmith, one is a story unlock and one comes from a Legendary Chest.
Craft the three blacksmith shields — owning the materials alone is not enough.

achievements.name: Collector
achievements.description: Obtain all Relics and Sword Hilts

steps: Collect all 14 Relics (Sword Hilts): some come from bosses, some from Legendary Chests, and four must be crafted at a blacksmith after finding the 4 Lost Pages.
Craft every craftable Relic — a Relic only counts once it has been crafted.
One Relic is the reward for killing all 48 of Odin's Ravens and beating the Raven Keeper; check The Eyes of Odin progress if that is the one you are missing.
communityNotes: Reddit tip: the raven relic is why all 48 Odin's Ravens are mandatory even though no trophy names them.
warnings: Several players report some Relics failing to appear as craftable even with every Lost Page and material — check the blue chest beside the blacksmith for loot you missed.

achievements.name: Dragon Slayer
achievements.description: Craft the Dragon Scaled Armor Set

steps: Complete Main Quest 13: Creatures of Prophecy and Favor: Scent of Survival to unlock The Crater in Vanaheim.
Finish your first Dragon Hunt in The Crater to make the Dragon Scaled set available at the blacksmith.
Craft all three pieces: Breastplate (1 Dragon Claw, 2 Dragon Teeth), Bracers (10 Dragon Teeth) and Girdle (10 Dragon Teeth).

achievements.name: How it's Going
achievements.description: Fully repair the Amulet of Yggdrasil

steps: Get the Amulet of Yggdrasil during Main Quest 06: The Reckoning, after the Níðhögg fight.
Find the seven missing Jewels of Yggdrasil — they come from Legendary Chests across the realms.
Repair all nine slots at a blacksmith; two start unlocked, so seven jewels finish it.
Finish the main story — Favor: A Viking Funeral does not exist before that.
Start the favor in Svartalfheim and attend Brok's funeral.
warnings: Not missable, but the favor is unavailable until the campaign is complete.

achievements.name: Rebel Leader
achievements.description: Return the Hammer of the Rebellion

steps: Complete Favor: Spirit of Rebellion in Svartalfheim.
Return the Hammer of the Rebellion to Durlin in the Nidavellir tavern.
Complete Favor: The Mysterious Orb for Lúnda — she offers it at Freyr's Camp in Vanaheim.
Recover her orb and bring it back to her.
Complete Favor: Secret of the Sands and Favor: Song of the Sands in Alfheim — both only appear after the story.
Free one Hafgufa in The Barrens and the other in The Forbidden Sands.
Complete Favor: The Weight of Chains in Svartalfheim.
Free the Lyngbakr chained in the Bay of Bounty, off Lyngbakr Island.
Complete Favor: Freya's Missing Peace in Vanaheim.
Recover the Mardöll sword from the Vanir Shrine and give it to Freya.

achievements.name: Invasive Species
achievements.description: Complete all of the Crater Hunts

steps: Unlock The Crater in Vanaheim through Favor: Scent of Survival.
Complete all nine hunts there — seven Dragon Hunts and two Epic Hunts, spread across The Jungle, The Sinkholes and The Plains.
Complete Favor: Animal Instincts at the Lake of Nine in Midgard.
Defeat the raiders who imprisoned the wolves Speki and Svanna, then pet both wolves.

achievements.name: Rightful Place
achievements.description: Return all the Lindwyrms to Ratatoskr

steps: Start Favor: The Lost Lindwyrms at Sindri's House.
Capture all six Lindwyrms across the realms and hand each one back to Ratatoskr.

achievements.name: Pure of Hart
achievements.description: Return the Stags of the Four Seasons

steps: Start Favor: A Stag for All Seasons at Sindri's House.
Find all four lost stags — one per season — in The Crater region of Vanaheim.
Reach the Crucible in Muspelheim and work through the trials — 15 in total, made up of 9 Trials and 6 Challenges.
Clear every one of them to finish Favor: The Final Challenges.
Upgrade all three pieces of one matching armor set — chest, wrist and waist — to Level 9.
The pieces must share the same set name; mixing pieces from different sets does not count.
Upgrade at any blacksmith. You will have enough materials from normal story and exploration progress.
Story trophy: unlocks during Main Quest 17: The Realms at War, after the Odin boss fight.
Collect all 10 Berserker Gravestones and defeat the 13 Berserkers inside them.
King Hrólf then appears at King's Grave in Midgard for Favor: Fit for a King.
Fight him at Gear Level 9 with a Resurrection Stone, and turn on Settings > Accessibility > Combat > Miniboss Checkpoints to save halfway through.
warnings: Hrólf is a Level 9 boss and the hardest Berserker — do not attempt him under-levelled.
Difficulty does not affect trophies: switching Challenge Level to Give Me Story is a legitimate shortcut.

steps: Finish the main story — Gná only spawns afterwards, in the Crucible in Muspelheim.
Complete Favor: Defend Your Valor.
Beat her at Gear Level 9 with a Resurrection Stone; she is one of the two hardest fights in the game.
warnings: Gná does not appear at all until the campaign is complete.

steps: On your first Valhalla attempt, let Kratos die — the story only advances through death and return.
After that, clear attempts without dying to move through the six story chapters. Touchpad > Goals > Valhalla tracks them.
The trophy unlocks after beating Týr for the fourth time, at the end of Chapter 6: The Work, Part 3: Benevolence.
Start the Valhalla DLC and play until Kratos dies.
The trophy unlocks after the first death cutscene, which opens Chapter 1: The Invitation.
Reach Chapter 2: Homecoming and play far enough into an attempt to meet Helios.
Perform the sacrifice when the Helios section forces it — it ends the run and returns you to The Shore.
Play through an attempt until you reach the boss at the end — the fourth run at the earliest.
Defeat Týr and leave through the gate to end the run; this opens Chapter 3: The Host.
Start a run after beating Týr once — your fifth run at the earliest.
Pick up the glowing Oath Stone when it appears on the way to Týr; this starts Chapter 4: The Work, Part I: Acceptance.
Visit all nine realms inside Valhalla.
Six realms show up randomly, but three are tied to the weapon bonus you take from the first chest — finish one run with the Axe, one with the Blades and one with the Spear to see all three.
warnings: Taking the same starting weapon every run permanently hides the other two weapon-specific realms.

steps: Start a run after beating Týr three times — your seventh run at the earliest.
Pick up Pandora's Statue when the story forces it, on the way to the fourth Týr fight.

achievements.name: Fight at the Forum
achievements.description: Participate in a fight at The Forum arena

steps: Finish the six-chapter Valhalla story, then start another run.
In the foggy maze before Týr, defeat the Chosen and head upstairs to reach The Forum — the third arena, which opens after you beat Týr a fourth time.
Play one match in The Forum.

achievements.name: Easy Come, Easy Go
achievements.description: Acquire more than 15,000 Fleeting Echoes on a single attempt

steps: Bank more than 15,000 Fleeting Echoes in one attempt — the counter resets every run, so this cannot be ground out across sessions.
Defeat the Chosen in the foggy maze for score multipliers, then play the arenas.
Clearing all three arenas in a single run comfortably passes 30,000, and the Forum run for Fight at the Forum gets you there automatically.
Open Touchpad > Goals > Mastery and complete any nine Mastery Quests.
The easiest nine are the three Rage and three Shield masteries (swap your Rage or Shield before each attempt), Travel Mastery, Greek Labyrinth Mastery and Permanent Upgrade Mastery.
Talk to the Valkyries at The Shore after each one — a mastery only counts once it has been turned in.
warnings: Completing a mastery without turning it in at The Shore does not count towards the nine.

steps: Die once, then finish a run so you are returned to The Shore.
Interact with the glowing pillar in the hub to change Kratos' cosmetic appearance.
Unlock Pandora's Statue first — Boat Captain Keys do not spawn before that.
On every attempt after that, collect the purple key in the first chamber, in front of the wooden painting next to the first chest.
Finish the attempt so the next key spawns, then repeat until you have all three.
warnings: A run you die in does not spawn the next key.
Some players see keys earlier than the guide states, once the Oath Stone is collected — check the first chamber every run regardless.
